headline: North-West complaints doubled almost entirely because our warehouse missed delivery promises.
body: North-West alone drove nearly all the increase, with complaints jumping from 24 to 60 [E1]. The WH-07 conveyor failure on June 25 cut throughput 60% and left us short 14 pickers [E6]. Customers are noticing—one enterprise account already cited three missed deliveries in June and is shifting volume to a competitor [E3]. Until WH-07 is fixed, we'll keep seeing late deliveries and complaints on North-West lanes.

actions.driver: Fulfilment SLA breaches from WH-07 disruption
actions.action: Notify affected customers early and offer goodwill credits now
actions.expected_impact: Reduces complaint escalation while WH-07 recovers
actions.monitoring: Track weekly complaint volume for North-West lane

what_could_change: Confirmation that WH-07 throughput is restored to normal would ease this concern quickly.
caveats: This links complaints to SLA misses but doesn't prove the warehouse issue is the only cause.
escalation_brief: Escalate WH-07 conveyor repair timeline to ops leadership given enterprise churn risk in North-West.
